variants.name: mist_peaks
variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background texture for a portrait 9:16 Chinese xianxia aerial battle mobile game, 1080x1920 pixels or larger. Create a finished painterly game background plate, no interface and no characters. Refined Chinese fantasy landscape matte painting, sophisticated atmospheric depth, very low saturation, soft medium-dark grey blue and teal values. The central 70 percent of the entire image is extremely quiet empty air and softly graduated distant mist, suitable behind flying 3D fighters and bright spells. The camera is floating high in the sky, no walkable floor, no arena, no platform. Mountains appear only at far outer edges and in extreme distance as softly dissolved silhouettes, never prominent behind central combat. Upper 10 percent and lower 25 percent gently deepen in value for readable game overlays, no hard bands. Clouds are broad soft silk-like mist layers, not intricate highly contrasted cotton clumps. Fine professional painterly tonal texture, no visible paper grain. Avoid characters, creatures, people, letters, text, UI, symbols, borders, architecture, buildings, red leaves, giant moon, sun disc, beams, lighting rays, lightning, bright white cloud clusters, saturated vivid colors, sharp central peaks, ground platforms. Not a collage, one continuous full bleed scene. Dawn mist peaks: cool slate blue mountain silhouettes along far left and right margins, faint pearl-blue ambient dawn behind a smooth central sea of blue-grey haze. Quiet, spacious, elegant, without a bright center hotspot.
